style: Semi-realistic catalog rendering, pure white background, centered complete subject, generous padding, soft shadow, no invented brands or watermark.

prompts.postage-stamp: A small perforated Japanese postage stamp with a delicate cherry blossom illustration, unattached with all four perforated edges visible. No price, no text, no cancellation mark. A single flat paper stamp standing at a slight angle.
prompts.postcard: One Japanese blank postal postcard viewed from its address side, portrait orientation, seven small red postal-code boxes near the top, fine dividing line and a small stamp affixed in top-left. No other letters or readable addresses.
prompts.letter: One handwritten personal paper letter with orderly short gray handwriting strokes, partially unfolded next to its open plain white envelope. Letter sheet is the prominent subject. No readable words, no brand.
prompts.parcel: A single securely wrapped small brown kraft-paper postal parcel, tied neatly with cotton string, a small white generic shipping label and a stamp. Entire object sealed, no contents exposed, no text.
prompts.postal-counter: An isolated compact Japanese post-office service counter unit, off-white and muted red, one transaction window, a parcel scale and a parcel on the counter, red standardized 〒 symbol above. No people, no bank ATM, no invented words or brand. Small architectural cutaway vignette floating on pure white.
prompts.shipping-label: One Japanese domestic parcel shipping form on a small kraft parcel corner, overhead close three-quarter view. Main focus white rectangular adhesive label, distinct red and blue ruled sender and recipient fields, modest black barcode and address lines with no readable personal details. No invented words or brand.
prompts.delivery-notice: Selected regenerated version: only 不在票 heading; blank form fields and clock symbol, no other text.
prompts.postal-scale: A compact Japanese post-office digital postal scale with a flat metal weighing platform and an upright small LCD readout. A flat kraft envelope rests on the platform. Scale is dominant and fully visible. No kitchen bowl, no bathroom foot platform, no brand, no decorative surroundings.
prompts.cardboard-box: A single open brown corrugated cardboard shipping box, four open flaps, visible corrugated edge thickness and folded base, empty inside. Entire box and all flaps visible. No contents, no label, no text.
prompts.packing-tape: A single wide roll of tan-brown packing tape with paper core, a short peeled-back tape end showing sticky underside. Thick broad 48mm tape, clearly heavy duty carton-sealing tape, not narrow office tape. No dispenser, no text or brands.
prompts.bubble-wrap: One loosely rolled sheet of transparent polyethylene bubble wrap, a portion unrolled across white surface. Clearly visible uniform round air bubbles, translucent plastic edges. Nothing wrapped inside, no extra objects.
prompts.padded-envelope: One kraft-brown padded bubble mailing envelope with top flap open, silver translucent inner bubble cushioning visible at the mouth, a small edge folded outward to reveal the padded lining. Entire rectangular mailer visible, no label or text.
prompts.registered-mail: One Japanese registered postal letter in a clean white envelope, a small tracked-mail barcode sticker and clear red standardized marking 書留. Stamp upper left, seven postal code boxes top right. No personal names, no other readable text, no brand. Entire envelope shown front-on at slight three-quarter angle.
prompts.express-mail: One Japanese domestic express letter, vertical white envelope with the defining thick horizontal red express stripe along its top edge and exact small red marking 速達. Small stamp upper left, seven red postal-code boxes. No other readable words, no personal data, no brand. Whole envelope clearly visible.
prompts.postmark: Use case: product-mockup. Square close-up educational catalog illustration of ONE Japanese postal POSTMARK (消印). The SUBJECT IS THE BLACK INK MARK, not the envelope. Show a large black circular cancellation ring with simple date 10.22, stamped across a small blue floral postage stamp and the surrounding flat white paper. The ring must occupy about 55 percent of square width, the stamp about 45 percent. Show only a neat rectangular piece of the envelope front as support, with generous white margins; this is an enlarged detail, do NOT draw a whole envelope. The paper is a continuous flat white rectangle: no triangular flaps, no seams, no folds. Strong crisp charcoal-black ink circle crosses the stamp edge to visibly cancel it. No other text, no invented brand. Semi-realistic soft paper rendering, clean pure white background, isolated centered complete mark and paper patch, ample padding. Absolutely no tiny mark in a big blank envelope.
prompts.household-mailbox: A single Japanese residential wall-mounted mailbox, brushed silver rectangular metal box with slanted rain-cover flap over horizontal letter slot, small lock on lower retrieval door, mounted on a tiny neutral white wall panel. No freestanding public red postal box, no 〒 symbol, no text or brand.
prompts.category-postal-services: A compact recognizable modern Japanese neighborhood post office facade, white walls with restrained red fascia, clear standard 〒 symbol above glass entrance, and one red public Japanese pillar-style post box beside entrance. Complete miniature architectural vignette isolated on white, no street scenery, no invented brand words, no people.
